functions.path_data: (theta[M,192],alpha[64],HS[M,64],arcs,D,beta,I=16,U=4,stabilized=False) -> full positive PH/Gauss transfer weight and interval data
functions.stable_hs_slice: (HS,data,l,rng) -> exact local-HS conditional slice with stabilized cyclic Green; same target law
functions.interval_vertices: (theta_l,arcs,V,dt,f,need_same=False,spectral=None) -> (T_f,T_fconjugate,T_ffconjugate,T_ff optional,contact_only_T_ffconjugate); all first/second Frechet interval insertions

array_meanings.source_hessian: [qpol,n], FULL partition W''/W response, not irreducible; n0 is an ensemble static-shift Ward diagnostic, not electric zero-frequency inversion
array_meanings.logdet_hessian: [qpol,n], paired conditional logdet second derivative; missing conditional-mean feedback if used alone
array_meanings.source_one: [qpol,n], conditional full paired W'/W; empirical means should be symmetry-compatible, not forcibly zeroed
array_meanings.interval_contact: [qpol], -source-contact-Hessian/dt; exact source-contact interval derivative, not substituted point-current contact
array_meanings.interval_current_matsubara: [qpol,n], (source_hessian-contact_Hessian)/dt^2; includes full connected interval virtual response and annealed feedback
array_meanings.EE_matsubara: [qpol,n], sum_lag exp(+2pi i n lag/M) EE(lag). n!=0=-source_hessian/(4sin^2(pi n/M)); n0 independently inserted from compact kinetic kernels
array_meanings.qminus_EE_matsubara: Same actual paired insertions exchanged (q,n)<->(-q,-n); q-minus from all independently evaluated temporal n, not a second independent chain
array_meanings.direct_EE_matsubara: Independent, high-variance direct kinetic-bond electric insertions, all n including exact same-bond contact
array_meanings.D_E: dt*EE_matsubara, electric-source susceptibility; no pole fit or Maxwell completion
array_meanings.D_B: dt*sum_lag exp(+2pi i n lag/M) <sin(F_xpol)_q(lag) sin(F_xpol)_-q(0)> from same new paths; no magnetic energy term added
array_meanings.derivative_step_difference: Cold-only selected h/2 minus h source-Hessian derivative differences; unexercised entries are zero with explicit step_comparison_exercised mask
array_meanings.max_source_matrix_condition: Analytic hot branch measured condition; raw cold value0 means unmeasured, replaced by null in final response summary
array_meanings.compact_temporal_winding: Per-link integer gauge-representative winding diagnostic; not itself a gauge-invariant transverse flux-sector certificate

new_sampling: Own new angle/HS/holonomy initial inputs and full determinant/kinetic sampling. No ancestor producer CLI and no old evolved/raw arrays used as new physics. The analysis consumes only this prefix's newly produced paths.
physical_scope: Original same-charge law, Gauss-only original totalN64 mixture. Finite beta/M and finite chains. No photon pole, speed, Lorentz, groundstate, material mass, equilibrium or continuum certification.
